problems.reason: Add continuous-time unit steps u(t) and sided-signal representations; the existing step concept explicitly covers only discrete-time sequences.
Add the Laplace–CTFT relationship: evaluating a Laplace transform on the imaginary axis gives the CTFT only when that axis lies in the ROC.
System pole-zero analysis requires identifying the system transfer function H(s), rather than analyzing an arbitrary signal's Laplace transform; require transfer-functions at depth 3.
Computing magnitude and phase requires rectangular/polar complex arithmetic at depth 3; existing prerequisite paths require complex arithmetic only at depth 2.
Applying group-delay calculations requires applying differentiation at depth 3; raise both the prerequisite depth and differentiation's target from 2 to 3.
